I was a passenger in the front seat of our family car when we were struck in a parking lot on 2024-11-20 in Pearland.
My husband was driving slowly toward an open space near the store entrance when a vehicle backing out of a

scene. We were taken by ambulance to a nearby hospital for checks and were released the same evening.
